title: Agency Dashboard - Pixel One
metaDescription: Client dashboard at Pixel One Visuals for tracking orders, statuses, and account security updates.
texts: A quick overview of your agency activity and current project metrics.
Every request submitted from the home page appears here automatically with its delivery status.
Available order statuses: Received, Accepted, Needs Revisions, In Progress, Completed.
Manage email, password, and sensitive account protection actions.
Notice: Security messages such as password/email changes and MFA updates are sent by Supabase Email Templates.
